title: Choosing the Right Sanitaryware for Style & Comfort
htmlContent:
Choosing the right sanitaryware is an important decision to make when it comes to a designing or re-decorating your bathroom, and will determine the look and feel of your bathroom as well as its functional parts. This straight-forward guide will help you determine what to think about and what to expect when making those all important decisions.

With so many different types of sanitary ware available in the market such as high quality,  efficient wall hung W. C‘s, stylish wash basins and bidets etc,  your needs may need to be clearly and carefully considered to find out what is the best sanitary ware for you and your needs.  It is not just about selecting a W. C and a basin;  it is about designing a bathroom for your comfort and enhancement of elegance as well as sanitation. Proper sanitary ware will not only efficiently last for years to come but will also add to your pleasure.

The first step in the process of choosing the right sanitaryware is to determine the factors that will affect your choice(s), so you can be confident that your new bathroom will be both stylish and functional.  The most obvious of these factors is the type of toilet to be used; there are several varieties, including the traditional western type or the more contemporary wall-hung version, which provides a smoother,  more streamlined appearance and significantly increased ease of maintenance.

The other part to consider is the flush mechanism;  the use of rimless designs is becoming very widespread,  it offers better hygiene and is easier to keep clean as there are no nooks and crannies in which germs can gather and breed. Think about the wash basin, do you want a pedestal, counter-top or an under counter basin and how it would fit aesthetically into your new bathroom. The material used (most sanitaryware is ceramic) will have an influence over hygiene and the look of your bathroom.

Factors to Consider When Choosing Sanitaryware

Key Factors to Consider for Your Bathroom

As you begin your search to find you the perfect bathroom sanitaryware you want to be sure to look at a few things for both the aesthetic and not so aesthetic purposes.  Things such as the Size and lay out of your bathroom are very important as these sizes will determine which sanitary ware is the right size for you, for example, a smaller bathroom maybe suited with a small wash basin and wall hung toilet which will help give you the impression of an even larger bathroom not to mention give you that modern feel.  Things like the current plumbing and the ability to add new fittings are also important as some modern bathroom furniture now requires specific plumbing.  Then of course there is the style and décor of your home, you want a look that will match your current décor beit a classic stylish look or a simple combination of more modern equipment. Choosing something that is strong and low-maintenance will make for a more hygienic, happy bathroom.

Understanding Different Types of Toilets

Knowing what types of toilet are on the market is an essential part of selecting the perfect kind of sanitaryware for you to sit on.  Classic western toilet has long been the most common type, offering a comfortable and well-known design that even come in a variety of styles such as close coupled or back to wall. For a more minimalistic design that would look good in a contemporary bathroom, a wall-hung toilet is a great way to go,  with the bowl attached to the wall over the floor and a duct in the wall for the available concealed cistern,  making it the easiest bowl to clean with the most elegant look. Rimless toilet is also becoming more common as with the removal of the rim, there is less of a place for germs to build up in the bowl during a flush,  which makes them easier to clean and more hygienic. Newer models of commodes also offer automatic functions,  such as the more hi-tech smart toilet with a heated seat and built in bidets. Having more than one type of toilet in the bathroom is one good way of transforming your ‘regular’ bathroom into a bathroom to relax in.

Choosing the Right Toilet Seat Design

The design of the toilet seat might seem insignificant, but it does indeed make a substantial difference both visually and comfortably to the commode you have purchased along with your bathroom. When choosing a product along with your WC,  bear in mind the seat‘s material which will generally be ceramic or a resilient plastic composite, along with its shape and features.  An elongated toilet seat will be more comfortable than a round shaped edition, while any seats with soft-close capacities eliminate loud slamming and knick-knacking to the toilet fixture - avoiding damage and marking to the toilet itself while adding a quiet luxurious touch. Quick release toilet seats are also easy to clean and ideal for hygienic purposes,  and are easily detached into its component parts,  ready for cleaning. Some seats also feature a bidet built-in for more extensive clean, by having a bidet fitment.  Toilet seat design should complement the toilet you have chosen.

Guide to Selecting the Best Sanitaryware

Best Sanitaryware Options Available

Choosing your ideal sanitaryware can be a difficult decision as numerous options and designs exist to suit every taste and practical requirement. Many modern sanitaryware designs have incorporated more practical uses and hygiene factors into their designs meaning your ideal bathroom can be achieved. The most common item of sanitary ware used in the traditional bathroom is the wall-hung toilet,  however these are now extremely common due to their space saving qualities and ease to clean, maximum hygienic standards can be obtained.  The rimless toilet design has also recently proven popular because they now contain a more efficient flush system which again benefits cleanliness and is also quick and easy to clean. Wash basins come in many different designs to suit the requirement, from under-counter wash basins for a more continuous appearance,  to statement counter top basins often made from a high quality ceramic to maximize to look and feel of the whole experience.

Sanitaryware in India: Trends and Choices

The market for sanitaryware in India is ever-enthusiastic with time and trends being synonymous. The focus here is shifting toward design and technology so as to satisfy the flow of everyday requirements in a bathroom. The enthusiasm for design and technology makes selecting sanitaryware and bathroom fixtures an interesting exercise. The evolving trend in India is towards healthy living and water conservation. These factors, along with the demand for cleanliness,  are giving rise to interesting sanitary ware trends such as introduction of rimless toilets and contemporary styles of bathroom fixtures with flush systems. The look of the bathroom is also an interesting consideration for Indian consumers with most of them opting for toilet seats exuding style with a good mix of furniture for perfect balance of interior design with look. Wall-hung commodes are gaining popularity in India as they take minimum space and are easy to clean,  making the bathroom hygenic. The latest trend can also be observed in designer wash basins and ceramic sanitaryware that satisfy durability and hygenesis along with style.

Evaluating Bathroom Fixtures for Style and Comfort

Considering the beauty and comfort of bathroom fixtures is extremely critical when looking to make your bathroom your place of retreat. You would want to make sure that you select the right sanitoryware items for your house so as to transform your bathroom into a heavenly retreat,  both in terms of aesthetics and comfort. The aesthetic appeal of your sanitoryware will definitely depend on the kind of finishing and shapes that you select and selecting a ceramic sanitoryware that boasts of sharp curves and refined shapes can dress up your Bathroom like no other. The comfort that your sanitoryware items will bring to your bathroom will depend on how effectively you select the right type of sanitoryware for your home and the design and shape of the sanitoryware pieces you select. a 5-star hotel whitewash is achieved by selecting right sanitoryware items and one would want to make sure that the whole range of sanitoryware items available such as the WC,  the urinal and the wash basin all match the color and attractiveness of the space.  The comfort created by the sanitoryware items will also depend on how well designed the Sanitary ware is- a good western commode and a well designed Bidet can add to the comfort of your bathroom and give it a heavenly feel.

Choosing the Right Toilet for Your Needs

Types of Toilets: Western Commode vs. Others

Once one begins the search for the perfect sanitaryware one of the first and most important decisions to be made is the type of toilet you wish.  There are many different types of toilet available now ranging from the traditional western style to more innovative designs.  Although the traditional western style toilet is still the most popular many people who are installing a new luxury bathroom desire the fresher and more modern wall hung toilet as it has a much more spacious feel about it and is very easy to keep clean and hygienic.  There are also other types of toilet such as the Bidet which is superbly hygienic and although very popular as a leisure fitting also is available in many modern western toilets.  Your choice of toilet will play a large part in you bathroom so think carefully about what would fit into your lifestyle and what look you would like it to portray.

Factors to Consider When Selecting a Toilet

To select the right toilet, there are a few important considerations to take into account in order to select the right bathroom Sanitary utensils. To start with, size of the bathroom is the first thing to be considered,  as a small and compact design of toilet,  if preferred,  will also give the desired effect.  A wall hung toilet might be a better choice for such bathrooms, as they give the impression of much more space and a cleaner and simpler image.  Another important consideration is the flushing system,  since this will affect the efficient utilization of water and ensure the health factors are adhered to. A rimless toilet flushing system promises a high powered/large flush which is quick and whole of the pan, and easy to clean, thus stopping bacteria from forming. Material and its type being another consideration here, as things like ceramic material is easily cleanable and long-lasting. Also the seat design is.

Flush Mechanisms and Their Importance

The flush mechanism is also an important feature to consider when selecting the most appropriate toilet for your needs, as it affects the functionality,  water-saving capability,  and hygiene of a pair of toilet fixtures. While developed and reliable,  the traditional washdown and siphonic flush designs are not always ideal from a hygiene standpoint,  as they can leave residue that is difficult to clean around the rim of the toilet bowl. In this regard,  newer toilet fixtures provide increased hygienic benefits through a more efficient flush.  For instance, a rimless toilet has its waterjet situated in a way that it can flush cleansingly around all surfaces of the bowl, and help facilitate any cleaning process through an open rim design. Many modern toilet fixtures also incorporate water-efficient features,  such as individual full and half flush options,  further improving the health and sanitation levels of the bathroom.
